Everything is done. Here's the complete picture:

---

## Healthcare Appointment System — Complete ✅

**`flutter analyze`: No issues | `flutter test`: 23/23 passed**

### File structure created

```
lib/
├── main.dart                          # MultiProvider + named routes + theme
├── theme/app_theme.dart               # Global MaterialApp theme
├── models/
│   ├── doctor.dart                    # Doctor model + 6 sample doctors
│   ├── appointment.dart               # Appointment model + status enum
│   └── user_profile.dart              # UserProfile model
├── providers/
│   ├── appointment_provider.dart      # book/cancel/complete + ChangeNotifier
│   ├── doctor_provider.dart           # search/filter + ChangeNotifier
│   └── profile_provider.dart         # profile + settings + ChangeNotifier
├── services/
│   └── health_quote_service.dart      # REST API (quotable.io) with http
├── widgets/
│   └── common_widgets.dart            # DoctorCard, SectionHeader, InfoTile,
│                                      # StatusChip, StatCard custom widgets
└── screens/
    ├── splash_screen.dart             # Animated splash (Fade+Slide+Scale)
    ├── home_screen.dart               # Dashboard (SliverAppBar, stats, nav)
    ├── doctor_list_screen.dart        # Search + filter + ListView.builder
    ├── doctor_detail_screen.dart      # Detail + hero header + book button
    ├── book_appointment_screen.dart   # Form + validation + DatePicker
    ├── my_appointments_screen.dart    # TabController (3 tabs) + cancel
    ├── health_tips_screen.dart        # Animations + REST API fetch/display
    └── profile_screen.dart            # View/edit profile + settings
test/widget_test.dart                  # 23 unit tests across all models+providers
```

### Syllabus coverage map

| Lab | Topic | Where |
|-----|-------|-------|
| 1 | Dart basics, OOP | All model classes |
| 2 | Text, Container, Row, Column, Stack | Every screen |
| 3 | MediaQuery, responsive layout | HomeScreen (tablet grid), DoctorList |
| 4 | Navigator + named routes | main.dart, all `pushNamed` calls |
| 5 | Stateful/Stateless, setState, Provider | All screens + 3 providers |
| 6 | Custom widgets, themes, styles | common_widgets.dart, app_theme.dart |
| 7 | Form, input fields, validation | BookAppointmentScreen, ProfileScreen |
| 8 | Animations (Fade, Slide, Scale) | SplashScreen, HealthTipsScreen (staggered) |
| 9 | REST API fetch + display | HealthTipsScreen → quotable.io |
| 10 | Unit tests, debugging | test/widget_test.dart (23 tests) |

### To run

```bash
cd uid_project
flutter pub get
flutter run        # on device/emulator
flutter test       # run unit tests
```
